diagrams.title: After: regional cells
diagrams.description: An opaque directory assigns EU-primary/secondary to A/B and US-home to C. Only the EU recovery branch passes the promotion gate.

diagrams.description: Detect, fence, place, restore, admit and reconcile. Failed prerequisites stop promotion, and uncertain operations remain held.

lab_assumptions: Toy policy: A/B allowed in EU only, verified fencing, RPO 60 seconds. Other readiness gates are assumed true here; Python tests exercise them separately. Recovery timing is a fixed 360-second plan, not a measurement.
